caption:
Turnover just ticked past $75K? You've got a deadline.

You must register for GST within 21 days of your GST turnover going over $75,000. That's turnover, not profit. Taxi and ride-sourcing drivers have to register from the start, whatever their turnover. Below the line, registering is optional, but once you're in you generally stay registered for at least 12 months.

Save this.

General info only, not personal advice.
